title: 第5章 猴王诞生第6章 进入水帘洞
content_zh:
花果山。
水帘洞外。
陆生表情有些古怪。
这个系统……还真是跟西方佛门对着干啊！
先是阻拦猴王出世。
现在又是阻止跳入水帘洞称王。
这妥妥是要破坏西游量劫的节奏啊！
至于第一个选择……
已经被陆生自动忽略了。
到现在为止。
陆生已经差不多摸清这系统的套路了。
他在心底吐槽：
“什么破系统！”
“明明可以直接发布任务。”
“却还要装模作样给出两个选择！”
还什么“水猴子”
……
这是个正经称号吗？
吐槽归吐槽。
陆生此时还是得思考，如何才能完成任务。

正在这时。
老白猿已经看向所有猴子，高声道：
“看到那座瀑布了吗？”
“谁能跳入那瀑布之内，便是我们的王！”
老白猿的话音落下。
整个猴群都开始热闹起来。
无数猴子跃跃欲试。
但很可惜。
随着时间一分一秒过去。
始终没有哪一只猴子，敢率先起跳。
原因很简单。
这瀑布实在太大，水流太过湍急。
一旦没能跳入瀑布，那必然会被洪流冲走！
前世时。
陆生在电视上看这一幕时。
觉得这群猴子选王有些太过儿戏了。
区区一瀑布，又有什么难度？
直到这一刻。
陆生真正站在这宛如天幕般的瀑布前。
他才终于明白。

原来，这“水帘洞选猴王”
content_en:
Huaguoshan.
Outside the Water Curtain Cave.
Lu Sheng's expression was a little strange.
This system... is really at odds with Western Buddhism!
First, prevent the Monkey King from being born.
Now it's time to stop jumping into the water curtain cave to become king.
This is definitely going to disrupt the rhythm of Journey to the West!
As for the first option…
It has been automatically ignored by Lu Sheng.
Until now.
Lu Sheng has almost figured out the routines of this system.
He complained in his heart:
"What a broken system!"
"Obviously we can issue the task directly."
"But you still have to pretend to give two choices!"
What else is "water monkey"?
…
Is this a serious title?
Complaints are complaints.
Lu Sheng still had to think about how to complete the task at this time.
At this moment.
The old white ape had looked at all the monkeys and said loudly:
"See that waterfall?"
"Whoever can jump into that waterfall will be our king!"
The old white ape finished speaking.
The whole monkey group became lively.
Countless monkeys are eager to try.
But it's a pity.
As time passes by.
No monkey dared to take the lead in jumping.
The reason is simple.
This waterfall is too big and the water flow is too fast.
If you fail to jump into the waterfall, you will definitely be washed away by the torrent!
In previous lives.
When Lu Sheng was watching this scene on TV.
I think it’s a bit childish for these monkeys to choose a king.
Just a waterfall, how difficult is it?
Until this moment.
Lu Sheng actually stood in front of this waterfall that was like a sky curtain.
He finally understood.
It turns out that this "Water Curtain Cave Selects the Monkey King"
